verdict.rationale: Whisper is a speech-recognition model, library and transcription API. Autonomous background automations or agentic workflows fall outside that product category. The evidence describes only on-demand transcription and translation of audio files or streams via CLI, Python or API calls, and nothing shows it ships a scheduling or automation capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
